asset.name: CodeBlock
asset.description: The code presentation with lazily loaded highlighting, language metadata, line numbers, wrapping control, emphasized lines, copy and download, and a plain-text fallback.

requires.reason: Monospace rendering and overflow are shared.
Copy affordance and success feedback are shared.

rationale: Already implemented in the catalog at 0.3.1. Highlighting is lazy on purpose: a syntax highlighter in the base bundle is one of the largest avoidable costs in a component library.
